question: Should this timeline feature wait for the metadata-only audit ledger and lifecycle security contract, or should maintainers approve a narrower ephemeral timeline surface now?
rationale: The user value is clear, but the implementation choice controls persistence, cross-session visibility, redaction, and whether this duplicates existing Activity and trajectory state.

options.title: Build on audit ledger first
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98521 to define durable metadata, authorization, redaction, and query semantics before adding timeline UI/CLI surfaces.

options.title: Approve ephemeral timeline only
options.body: Keep the new surface browser/session-local and derived from existing live events, accepting that it will not satisfy durable JSON export or historical timelines.

options.title: Decline broad timeline
options.body: Keep Activity and trajectory export as the supported observability paths and close or narrow this issue after documenting that product decision.

recommendation.title: Build on audit ledger first
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98521 to define durable metadata, authorization, redaction, and query semantics before adding timeline UI/CLI surfaces.
